Feature availability
The case describes one row as: A vehicle model for a model year. For each variable you decide whether it is known at the prediction moment.

The intended use is: Exercise: estimate a future model fuel efficiency from technical characteristics. A model is adopted only when it reduces the error of the mean baseline by more than the variability of these validation rows, and its residuals do not show a bias that matters for that use.
